maria.accounts: Heads up — Sable Ledger sent invoice INV-98421 for $12,450 USD. Vendor references PO# 78942 in their PDF, but our procurement system shows no matching PO. Invoice attached. AP queue is blocked and approver routing is failing. Can purchasing confirm PO or advise route? Need resolution before EOD for month-close.
invoice-bot: invoice-bot uploaded INV-98421 (status: pending_qa) — attached file: sable_INV-98421.pdf
tom.finance: @aleks.purchasing do you own PO 78942? If not, who requested this so we can route approval? :eyes:
aleks.purchasing: I searched the purchasing system — no PO 78942 exists here. Vendor probably used an internal ref. Can you paste the invoice header lines or a screenshot? sometimes the PO shows up in a different field.
maria.accounts: Attached snippet from the PDF: ```Vendor: Sable Ledger
Invoice: INV-98421
Reference: PO 78942
Amount: 12,450.00 USD``` Also added the full scanned PDF to the thread.
jen.ops: I see a related requisition RQ-1209 for ~$12k from Nov that never converted to a PO. @aleks.purchasing could that map? Amount is off by $450 — maybe freight or tax.
aleks.purchasing: Looking at RQ-1209 now. If it's the same work, we can retro-create a PO and route it, but vendor should ideally reissue invoice with our PO#. Emma (procurement approver) is OOO today which could slow approval. Will check line items.
tom.finance: For month-close we can process this as a non-PO invoice with a payment hold and require written approval from the ENG cost center owner. Maria — can you confirm GL and cost center to route for approval?
maria.accounts: GL: 6002, Cost center: Platform-ENG. Description on invoice says "standard support". I'll add a comment: "pending PO verification — do not pay until ENG approver confirms."
aleks.purchasing: OK — I'll create PO 78942-RETRO and route to Emma for sign-off. @tom.finance please place payment hold in AP until procurement & ENG approve. :thumbsup:
invoice-bot: invoice-bot status update INV-98421 -> on_hold_by_finance
tom.finance: Noted. If procurement can't confirm and get sign-off by EOD we'll escalate to @finance-leads for an interim approval path.
maria.accounts: Added vendor contact (sally@sableledger.com) and put invoice in "month-end hold" queue. Will follow up with vendor to request a corrected invoice referencing our PO once it's created.
